name: VisualStateMachineEditorWindow
src_typeComment: Node-graph editor for VisualStateMachineAsset — double-click an asset to open it (or Toolkit/AI/Open Visual State Machine Editor with one selected). Functional-first scope, per design: drag out State/Any-State nodes (grid-snapped, colored per-node for readability), connect ports to create transitions, edit a selected transition's conditions and a selected node's name/color/entry-flag in the side panel, manage parameters from the toolbar. Every edit writes straight back into the asset and marks it dirty — there is no separate Save step to forget.

src_members.sig: public static bool OnOpenAsset(int instanceId, int line)

OnGraphDataChanged
src_members.comment: Called by VSMGraphView whenever it deletes nodes/edges (Delete key, etc.) so the underlying asset data and the sidebar both stay in sync with what's actually left in the graph.
